brand.title: Sign in to the freight services market

tariffs.title: Open tariffs and today's slots
tariffs.body: Terminal prices and free windows are visible without an account.

booking.title: Booking and documents
booking.body: Book a slot; the act and invoice are ready in your cabinet.

listing.title: Post a listing
listing.body: Rent out or sell a locomotive, wagon or truck.

brand.note: Browsing needs no account. Sign in only for contacts, bookings and listings.

login.lead: Sign in with your phone and password. No password yet? Use a code.

err.noPassword: This number has no password yet.
err.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {min} min.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.lead: The code arrives in the Telegram bot. Enter the code and a new password.

attach.title: Link your phone number
attach.lead: You signed in with Google. Bookings and listings need a phone: the code arrives in the Telegram bot.

google.disabled: Google sign-in is disabled for now.

err.phoneTaken: This number is linked to another account.

register.title: Register
register.lead: Phone, password, profile, done: four steps.

password.title: Set a password
password.lead: Next time sign in without a code: phone and password.
password.err: Could not save the password, try again.

profile.title: Profile

intent.title: What do you want to do?

need.title: I am looking for a service
need.body: You need a terminal, a slot, equipment or a carrier. We only ask for your name.

offer.title: I provide a service
offer.body: You own a terminal, a private siding, equipment or trucks. You will post listings.

driver.title: Individual driver
driver.body: You work with your own truck. The listing goes out under your name.

org.title: Organization
org.body: A company, terminal, forwarder or equipment owner. Listings appear under the organization name.

profile.driverLead: Your name appears on the listing. The phone shows as verified.
profile.lead: Start with one organization, add the rest in the cabinet.

err.stirTaken: This tax ID belongs to another organization.
err.invalidStir: The tax ID must be 9 digits.

profile.shipperLead: Only your name is needed. Organization and tax ID are asked at the first order or when documents are issued.

done.title: Done
done.lead: {org} is created. Pick your next step.
done.driverLead: Driver profile is ready. Post your first listing.
done.kycHint: Listings of a verified organization go live immediately without review. Enter the tax ID and request verification in the cabinet.
done.driverHint: Individual driver listings go live after review.
done.shipperLead: Your account is ready. You can start looking for a terminal.
done.shipperHint: An organization is created automatically with your first order; the tax ID is asked when documents are issued.
